rows.note: Use this as the all-purpose spoken choice for saying that something is true for the most part or broadly speaking.

example.traditional: 基本上呢個計劃已經完成喇。
example.jyutping: gei1 bun2 soeng6 ni1 go3 gai3 waak6 ji5 ging1 jyun4 sing4 laa3

rows.note: Use this when largely means that most people, cases, or occasions fall into the stated category.

example.traditional: 多數人都贊成呢個做法。
example.jyutping: do1 sou3 jan4 dou1 zaan3 sing4 ni1 go3 zou6 faat3

rows.note: Use this when largely means chiefly or primarily, especially when identifying the main cause, factor, or purpose.

example.english: The delay is largely due to heavy traffic.
example.traditional: 延誤主要係因為交通太塞。
example.jyutping: jin4 ng6 zyu2 jiu3 hai6 jan1 wai6 gaau1 tung1 taai3 sak1
